name: Notion External Agents
desc: Run Claude, Cursor and other outside agents from Notion.
desc_zh: 在 Notion 里给 Claude、Cursor 等外部智能体派活
solves: Agents in CLIs and IDEs work where teammates cannot see them. External Agents take tasks from a shared Notion board and report back.
solves_zh: 命令行和 IDE 里的智能体干活，同事看不见也接不上。外部智能体从共享的 Notion 看板接任务，结果大家都能看到。
best_for: A support ticket needs a code fix and you want to hand it to Cursor without leaving the team's board.
best_for_zh: 一个工单需要改代码，你想直接把它派给 Cursor，而不用离开团队看板。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.notion.com/releases/page/2）。 First announced on 2026-05-13 as an alpha behind a waitlist (inside the Developer Platform announcement, which says 'Join the External Agents waitlist'); the usable launch with Notion 3.6 is 2026-07-01, which is the date used. The quote ending 'in Notion' is truncated before its final period because the period follows a link on the page.
